snippet.title: Apple Picker - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮Wishlist Apple Picker on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4573410/Apple_Picker/

🍎___________________________________🧞
Start with a humble apple tree to become the greatest apple producer in this idle clicker incremental game. Buy absurd generators, upgrade them, ascend to unlock talents, rebirth to reach new heights. But... is that unicorn a fruit of your imagination? Find out why you're so obsessed with apples.
🦄___________________________________ 👁️
